scope: The five native Spark training attempts whose weights lead to the destination_v9 checkpoint, each started from the previous attempt's final checkpoint, and the native learning-probe evaluation of each. Every evaluation ran the source its training ran (equal source freeze hashes). Checkpoints and raw runs stay on Spark under /srv/cupi/hexapod/runs/julian.
standing_admission: Steps 1 to 4 read the standing captures and admission candidate under /srv/cupi/hexapod/runs/james/python_standards_20261017_001 read-only; step 0 read /srv/cupi/hexapod/inputs/flat_pilot_20260930_001/admission_128.

chain.change: Trained from scratch from the stance prior (no motion prior) with the reward submitted in PR 71: tracking, tripod schedule, yaw gate, stride tracking and stride length; termination 22; 48 controls per update.

chain.description: Get the optimal walk (the ghost) as input
chain.change: Experiment destination_v1: five destination inputs (the network's first layers widened with zero columns, so it starts as the PR model), 1.0 * exp(-d / 3 cm) every control for the planar distance to the destination, 20 s commands and episodes, termination 32; noise and learning rate restarted.

chain.description: Tighten the reward for following the ghost and solve heading and joint problems
chain.change: Experiment destination_v8: destination pay 1 / (1 + (d / 3.7 mm)^1.2) paid under every command (from destination_v5), heading pay 1 / (1 + (gap / 1 deg)^1.2) to the destination's heading with termination 42 (from destination_v7), and the ten joint penalties doubled.

chain.change: Experiment destination_v9: a fifth of the moving commands stop after 4 s to 12 s and stand for the rest of the 20 s; 600 updates continuing the checkpoint's learning rate (1e-5, ceiling 1e-4) at a fixed action deviation of 0.05.
